Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 3 June 2011); [[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), Dark Side p. 2: “[Pilot] 2. May be revealed from hand to ▲ Justifier and deploy both simultaneously (for -1 Force each). Opponent’s passengers here are forfeit = 0. Once per game, if aboard Justifier, may lose 1 Force to move away from battle as a ‘react’ (at hyperspeed +2).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), page 2, slip 2 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 3). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=3, page 3. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spells “revealed” as “reveled”, reads “lose one force” for “lose 1 Force”, drops the comma after “if aboard Justifier” and the quotation marks around “react” (it also writes the pilot icon and ▲ out in words): “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May be reveled from hand to take Justifier into hand from reserve deck; reshuffle and deploy both simultaneously (for -1 force each). Opponent's passengers here are forfeit = 0. Once per game, if aboard Justifier may lose one force to move away from battle as a react (at hyperspeed +2).”.<ref name="cl-1273_2-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of 14 March and 16 May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-admiralpellaeon-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “[Pilot] 2. May be revealed from hand to ▲ Justifier and deploy both simultaneously (for -1 Force each). Opponent’s passengers here are forfeit = 0. Once per game, if aboard Justifier, may lose 1 Force to move away from battle as a ‘react’ (at hyperspeed +2).” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 3)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “[Pilot] 2. May be revealed from hand to ▲ Justifier and deploy both simultaneously (for -1 Force each). Opponent’s passengers here are forfeit = 0. Once per game, if aboard Justifier, may lose 1 Force to move away from battle as a ‘react’ (at hyperspeed +2).” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-2-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
